clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity's northeast, Forsaken spellcasters study arcane and fel arts. The Temple of the Damned anchors their work.

In the Undercity's northeastern quadrant, Forsaken mages preserve arcane learning and explore darker arts. The Temple of the Damned dominates the district, a Scourge-built structure now used by the free-willed undead. Beneath its vaulted ceilings, mages shape magical energies while warlocks commune with demons. Their work makes the quarter a center of study and occult research in Lordaeron.

Spellcasters also come here for training and craft. Portal trainers maintain routes across Horde territories, and master tailors shape magically infused fabrics into robes and shrouds. In Dalaran, academic wizardry and forbidden magic are kept apart; Forsaken practitioners study arcane and fel power openly in the same halls, seeking strength against their many enemies.
